csv_scope_of_work: Richland County is soliciting Statements of Qualifications and Proposals from Design-Builders for a turnkey Emergency Operations Center (EOC) in an existing County Facility, pending funding availability. The selected Design-Builder will be the sole source responsible for the entire project, including architectural programming, design, and construction, holding all contracts for designers, trade contractors, and suppliers (excluding Owner-provided Special Inspections). This RFQ does not guarantee a contract award, nor will the County pay for proposal preparation costs. The County uses a qualification-based selection process, excluding fee consideration in the initial phase.
